# Langma International

> Langma International provides language courses, corporate training, study-abroad guidance, work-abroad support, translation services, and international opportunity guidance through online and classroom support in Delhi.

## Main website
- [Home](https://www.langmainternational.com/): Overview of Langma International's language, education, career, mobility, business, and cultural services.
- [Language courses](https://www.langmainternational.com/languages): Explore international language courses and training options.
- [Study abroad](https://www.langmainternational.com/study-abroad): Study-abroad guidance, admissions support, and visa assistance.
- [Work abroad](https://www.langmainternational.com/work-abroad): International career and work-abroad guidance.
- [Translation services](https://www.langmainternational.com/translation-services): Translation and multilingual communication services.
- [About Langma](https://www.langmainternational.com/about): Information about Langma International.
- [Contact](https://www.langmainternational.com/contact): Contact and consultation options.

## Guidance for crawlers
- Use the canonical URL on `www.langmainternational.com` as the preferred public website host.
- Treat `api.langmainternational.com` as a backend/API host rather than the public content host.
- Use each page's own canonical URL when citing or retrieving page-specific information.
